assertions.name: radius_of_convergence_gate_verified
assertions.source: §4(a) radius-of-convergence gate from conj:q-beta-radius-of-convergence-gate: verifies (1) PR #1727 cross-anchor u_substrate stability (210 ppb, well under 1 ppm fibre-level tolerance); (2) canonical SDP c_k satisfies the simple-pole signature (c_k·u^k tail-constancy, 1% spread bound); (3) gate ACCEPTS a synthetic candidate with rational simple pole at u_substrate exactly; (4) gate REJECTS a synthetic candidate with pole mislocated at 2·u_substrate. The operational form of the §3b-cond RadiusOfConvergenceGateClass Lean class; Step 4 of the 7-step Δ_λ pre-flight checklist.

description: Verifies the §4(a) radius-of-convergence gate from conj:q-beta-radius-of-convergence-gate. Reproduces PR #1727 anchor (u_substrate cross-anchor 210 ppb), the asymptotic ratio-test simple-pole signature on canonical SDP c_k, and demonstrates the gate's REJECT/ACCEPT behaviour on two probe candidates (one passing, one with deliberately-mislocated pole at 2·u_substrate). The operational form of the §3b-cond RadiusOfConvergenceGateClass Lean conditional class.
